message:
fix(host,test): the power switch is read by the host's one parser; the gate refuses any contradiction in a launch (test-injection-finding r5, Codex 6b9cf79 SOURCE P2-1 P2-2)

- P2-1: --host-power-management is read by parse_args with the same token / arity rules as every other switch
  (Args::hostPower); bind_host_power_policy (its own argv scan, which took another switch's operand for it) is gone.
  main() parses first -- parse_args reads arguments and a --config profile only, nothing in it acts on the machine --
  then builds HostPowerKeepalive from args.hostPower; startup_process_setup (priority, log prefix) after it reads
  nothing parse_args sets. Regression (host_power_policy_record_test, record-only, now via parse_args): a window
  title "--host-power-management" is the title (no error, default ON), with a stray "off" after it still no
  switch (not OFF), the real switch after the title -> OFF, as --bind-address's operand -> not the switch, its own
  operand only.
- P2-2: the gate checks EVERY "host power management=" and "input injection " line of the launch: one that
  differs anywhere -- before or after a matching one -- refuses it (power OFF, input OFF, then power ON -> refused;
  input OFF then enabled / another mode -> refused; the compile-time-policy line is not the explicit OFF -> refused);
  the same OFF lines twice still pass.

host_power_policy_record 27/27, injection_guard 20/20, record_match 9/9; all host variants and affected tests build;
the product GNLinkStream.exe has no record-only marker (gnlink_check_fixed_server 52/52). Not run.
